tasks.short: Adapt text to composers' and singers' requirements.

steps.what: Adapt the text to musical requirements
Accommodate what composers and singers ask

outputs: filed copy of signed adapted text v1

tasks.design: Adapting text to accommodate the musical requirements of composers and singers stays with the writer, including the conversation with them. A job files the adapted text in {DOCS} only after the writer signs it.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generated adaptation could ignore what the singer can actually sing.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed adaptation can be filed for the company.
tasks.still_hard: What can be sung, and what the writer will change, is still decided together.
tasks.human_edge: The writer adapts the text and signs it.
tasks.altitude: The adaptation stays. Filing the signed text shrinks.

evidence.claim: The media digest says creative writing stays manual.

assumptions: The job does not adapt the text.
unknowns: Which requirements are fixed by the music.
research_questions: How often a singer cannot meet a line.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the adaptation is the rewriting itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the term list or the format template when it changes, and clear any draft the writer rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the writer still adapts every line with the musicians. The high end assumes only the signed adaptation is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write humorous material for publication or performance.

steps.what: Write comedy routines, gags, and comedy shows

outputs: filed copy of signed humorous material v1

tasks.design: Writing humorous material for publication, or for performances such as comedy routines, gags, and comedy shows, stays with the writer in {DOCS}. A job files it only after the writer signs it. No model writes the joke.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generated joke could be performed as the writer's.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed routine can be filed for the performance.
tasks.still_hard: What is funny here is still the writer's judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The writer writes the material and signs it.
tasks.altitude: The writing stays. Filing the signed material shrinks.

evidence.claim: The media digest says creative writing stays manual.
Digest [S9] measured time on press releases, reports, and emails, not on fiction, poetry, or lyrics, so that time cut is not used as the saving here.

assumptions: The job does not write the material.
research_questions: How often a line fails in the room.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the material is the writing itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the term list or the format template when it changes, and clear any draft the writer rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every line is still the writer's. The high end assumes only the signed material is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.design: Teaching writing classes stays with the writer, in the room. A job files the class note in {DOCS} only after the writer signs it. No model teaches the class.

tasks.enabler_now: A signed note can be filed after the class.
tasks.still_hard: The teaching only happens with the students present.
tasks.altitude: The teaching stays. Filing the signed note shrinks.

reach.learn: That the note is not the class

assumptions: Nothing is sent to students before signature.
unknowns: Which classes the writer still teaches.
research_questions: How often the plan changes in the room.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the class is the teaching itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the term list or the format template when it changes, and clear any draft the writer rejects.

tasks.short: Collaborate with other writers on a project.

steps.what: Collaborate with other writers on specific projects

outputs: filed copy of signed collaboration note v1

tasks.design: Collaborating with other writers on specific projects stays with the writer. A job files the note in {DOCS} only after the writer signs the version they will stand behind. No model joins the collaboration.
tasks.previous_blocker: A merged text could include a line no writer had agreed.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed note can record what was agreed.
tasks.still_hard: The collaboration is the conversation and the shared writing.
tasks.human_edge: The writer agrees the text and signs their part.
tasks.altitude: The collaboration stays. Filing the signed note shrinks.

evidence.claim: The media digest says creative writing stays manual.
Digest [S16] says the journalism guideline rejects output tracking, and digest [S17] says that tracking needs works-council consent, so this design does not record how the writer works.

assumptions: The job does not merge or write.
Nothing is filed as agreed before signature.
The writers' working process is not tracked.
unknowns: Who owns a line written together.
research_questions: How often the writers are not in the same draft.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the collaboration is the work with the other writers.

incremental.description: Update the term list or the format template when it changes, and clear any draft the writer rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the writers still work together. The high end assumes only the signed note is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The writer spends the week on the work itself. A format check and sending a signed text can move. No model writes the fiction, the poem, or the lyric.
reach: A publisher receives only the text the writer signed.
A composer hears lyric changes from the writer, not from a generated line.
skills_to_grow: Reject a sentence that adds a fact or a quotation with no source row.
Keep the copyright steps, the reading, and the class as their own work.
role.ambitious_version: A signed text can go to a publisher the same week, and the writer still signs that version.
